newsitem.title: PERU: Peru net int'l reserves rise to $8.563 bln Dec 11.
newsitem.headline: Peru net int'l reserves rise to $8.563 bln Dec 11.

text.p: Peru's Central Reserve Bank said Friday its net international reserves rose to $8.563 billion on December 11 from $8.499 billion the week before.
The bank's foreign exchange position, or total liquidity minus short and long-term debt obligations, was $1.700 billion on the same day.
President Alberto Fujimori said earlier last month the government expected Peru's international reserves to rise above $10 billion by mid-1998.
